conversation.text: Welcome to Telecom Haiku support. Please have your account number ready.

conversation.text: Hi, thanks for calling. This is James with technical support. How can I help you today?

conversation.text: My service has been degrading. It started out fast, but now it's painfully slow.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I can definitely help with that. Let me check what's going on with your account.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: We might need to adjust your setup. Where's your router located?

conversation.speaker: agent

conversation.speaker: agent

conversation.speaker: agent
